messages:
aj_support: FYI — multiple EduScale trial orgs (5) reporting 'enrollment restricted' when inviting users. Blocks basic onboarding flows. Renewal conversation scheduled next Tue; flagging as high priority.

aj_support: sample error from logs:
```json
{"org_id":"eduscale-prod-23","user_email":"teacher@eduscale.edu","error":"ENROLLMENT_RESTRICTED","code":403,"msg":"org has reached enrollment cap: max_active_enrollments=50"}
```

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2028-842; priority: high; assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

maria_cs: Acknowledged. I'll own customer comms. Can you confirm which trials are affected (org ids + contact emails) and whether this started after the quota change you rolled yesterday? @devon_prod please weigh in on root cause.

aj_support: Affected orgs: eduscale-prod-23, eduscale-staging-7, eduscale-trial-11, eduscale-trial-12, eduscale-trial-14. All reported since 08:30 UTC after we applied enrollment-cap enforcement. I added support ticket IDs and attached logs to INC-2028-842.

devon_prod: Looking. Quick note: this is the new seat-cap enforcement landing that was enabled for all trials. We defaulted max_active_enrollments=50 for trial orgs. Workaround: we can flip the enforcement flag for specific orgs or bump cap. Command to toggle per-org (needs infra rights):
```bash
redwood-admin org-config set --org eduscale-prod-23 --key enrollment_enforcement --value false
# or bump
redwood-admin org-config set --org eduscale-prod-23 --key max_active_enrollments --value 200
```
I can do a targeted flip for the 5 orgs if we want an immediate unblock. Will need a support/ops signoff for per-org overrides.

sam_am: Please do the temporary flip — we need customers live before renewal talk. I'll prep a short note for EduScale explaining we hit a conservative enforcement threshold and we've applied a temporary exception while we review their usage. Maria, can you own the comms and include: timeline, impact, and next steps? I can join customer call.

maria_cs: On it. Draft comms I'll send to @sam_am for review and to legal if we mention terms. Draft outline: 1) apologize + brief cause 2) confirm we've applied temporary exception 3) propose a 30-min enablement walk-through to review seat needs 4) next steps re: long-term cap plan.

aj_support: Confirmed I've created support change request CR-4582 that authorizes devops to toggle org-level enforcement for the 5 orgs. Also added the renewal flag in SFDC for primary contact.

devon_prod: Executing temporary flip now for the five orgs. I'll post back once done.

devon_prod: Done — enrollment_enforcement=false for all 5 orgs. Verified invites now succeed in staging. Sample response: 200 OK / invite_created.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll send the customer note and propose Wed 09:00 PT for the enablement call. Sam — can you add calendar invite?

sam_am: Invite out to primary contact and internal shadow attendees. Subject: "EduScale — onboarding unblock + seat review".

maria_cs: Action items recap: (1) CS sends comms + schedule call (maria_cs) (2) AM joins call + handles renewal framing (sam_am) (3) Eng to follow up on cap tuning + product decision (devon_prod) (4) Support to monitor related alerts and close CR when permanent change agreed (aj_support). I'll update INC-2028-842 with the comms copy. :thumbsup:

aj_support: Thanks team — keeping INC-2028-842 as open until product decides on default trial cap.

ops_bot: Incident INC-2028-842 updated: status -> mitigated; notes added by devon_prod.
